rule: A mutant counts as caught only when its suite reaches the baseline check count and at least one check fails; a bash mutant also passes bash -n. Each mutant runs in its own copy of the files the suites read; targetFailed says whether the check the mutant was written for is among the failures.
baselineNote: Baselines are the runs at the measured commit; the PowerShell and bash suites ran side by side.
loadNote: Store mutants ran four at a time and PowerShell mutants two at a time, on one machine; seconds are wall times under that load. Bash mutants first ran three at a time, where every run also failed the same first-wave checks for time-outs; they ran again one at a time, and each row keeps the last run.
notRunHere: tests/Test-InstallerCheckpointStore.ps1: pwsh POSIX (real modes) and bash POSIX (real modes) checks of the state directory place
notRunReason: These checks run on Linux and macOS only (.github/workflows/installer-unix.yml); Git Bash on Windows reports fixed modes.
